description: Bundle size budgets per package. Every package gets a budget when created. Budgets are re-measured at Phase 13 and any raise must carry a note explaining why the real size exceeds the original placeholder.

@libregrid/core.note: Core singleton — beans, module def, guards, plus the shared control stylesheet, icon set, and theme-token helper added by the 1.1.0 UX pass (measures 16.3 KB).

@libregrid/menu.note: Context menu + column menu + registry + popup lifecycle + the column-filter popup + the 1.1.0 shared renderer (submenus, custom components, icons, keyboard nav). Raised from 40 KB after the 1.1.0 UX pass (measures 59.0 KB).

@libregrid/side-bar.note: Side bar shell with accessible controls, tool-panel host, events, and bounded resize. Raised from 21 KB after the 1.1.0 UX pass added icon-over-label buttons and focus styling (measures 23.0 KB).

@libregrid/material.note: Angular Material theme bridge plus optional menu, CDK portal side-bar, CDK columns-panel drag-drop, status-bar shell, and rich-select adapters. Raised from 30 KB at the Phase 13 audit after re-measuring the five adapters.

@libregrid/row-grouping.note: Group/flatten/agg/filterAgg/groupFilter stages + AggFuncService + rowGroup/value cols services + auto group column + expand/collapse + group sorting/totals + group filter/show-values-as/menu contributions. Raised from 95 KB at the Phase 13 audit (steady-state unminified output re-measured at 102.7 KB).

@libregrid/columns-tool-panel.note: Column tree, chooser overlay, row-group/value/pivot drop zones, standalone row-group header panel, framework-neutral drag adapter seam, deferred state, and full-grid reorder mapping. Raised from 47 KB at the Phase 13 audit for the pivot drop-zone and drag plumbing.

@libregrid/cell-selection.note: Range selection + fill handle. Raised from 20 KB at the Phase 13 audit — rangeService plus range model and fill-series detection measure 27.8 KB unminified.

@libregrid/clipboard.note: Browser Clipboard API support with a temporary-textarea fallback for range copying. Re-measured after validation-app copy support: 12.5 KB unminified.

@libregrid/status-bar.note: Status bar shell, service, and five provided panels. Raised from 8 KB after the 1.1.0 UX pass added the shell component, alignment buckets, and label/value rendering (measures 15.1 KB).

@libregrid/toolbar.note: Quick Access Toolbar shell, service, quick-filter and find items, and toolbar CSS. Added in the 1.1.0 UX pass (measures 17.9 KB).

@libregrid/excel-export.note: OOXML writer over fflate plus the grid extraction service. Raised from the 40 KB Phase-5 placeholder during delivery: 42.3 KB at 5.4, then 79.3 KB at 5.8 with the full extraction (grouped rows, callbacks, scope, page setup, protection, docProps) landed and 5.9 descoped.

@libregrid/set-filter.note: Virtualised set filter. Raised from 16 KB at the Phase 13 audit — the virtualised filter measures 21.1 KB unminified.

@libregrid/multi-filter.note: Composable multi filter. Raised from 8 KB at the Phase 13 audit — measures 8.5 KB unminified.

@libregrid/filters-tool-panel.note: Filter cards and deferred apply model. Raised from 10 KB after the 1.1.0 UX pass styling (measures 11.0 KB).
Accessible filters tool panel. Raised from 8 KB at the Phase 13 audit — measures 8.7 KB unminified.

@libregrid/server-side-row-model.note: Flat full/lazy root stores plus hierarchical grouping, analytical request forwarding, and server-driven pivot result columns. Raised from 32 KB at the Phase 13 audit — measures 40.3 KB unminified.

@libregrid/pivot.note: Client-side pivot stage, result-column generation, intersection aggregation, and pivot APIs. Passes at 15.8 KB after the Phase 13 audit removed spec files from dist.

@libregrid/advanced-filter.note: Serialisable expression AST + parser, reusable staged-model builder UI, and settings menu. Raised from 34 KB after the Phase 13 audit when the reusable builder landed; clean output measures 38.0 KB unminified.

@libregrid/rich-select.note: Accessible virtualised rich-select editor. Raised from 8 KB at the Phase 13 audit — measures 10.2 KB unminified.

@libregrid/integrated-charts.note: Chart adapter: range/pivot/cross-filter services, tool panel, provider seam. Raised from 16 KB at the Phase 13 audit — measures 26.0 KB unminified; ag-charts-community is a peer dependency and is not counted.

@libregrid/angular.note: Angular signal ergonomics, provideLibreGrid, and typed helpers.

@libregrid/batch-edit.note: Batch-editing module: the four reserved GridApi functions delegating to the Community edit service plus the pending-edit CSS.

@libregrid/calculated-columns.note: Calculated columns (Phase 17 / gap-plan A2): expression engine (tokenizer, parser, evaluator, provided functions), the `formula` bean (value pipeline + error hooks) and the `calculatedColsSvc` bean (dynamic-column lifecycle, dialog with pickers/autocomplete, menu items, events). Added with the feature; re-measure on first delivery.

@libregrid/all.note: Re-exports only — must not contain feature code. 3.8 KB of flat re-export statements measured at the Phase 13 audit.
